description: Ohtsuki kappa-series for 6_1 from ki6c eq.(29), with the bar pattern ((q) vs (qbar)) restored from Ohtsuki's 5_2 eq.(7) where the bars are legible -- PDF text extraction cannot see overlines (LaTeX rules, not glyphs). Evaluated in O(N^2) by convolution factorisation of the i<=j<=k chain. VALIDATED end-to-end on 5_2 against that paper's PUBLISHED sigma and omega before 6_1 is touched. Gate: fitted 6_1 sigma/omega must reproduce ki6c's printed values. kappa_i are the perturbative coefficients of the asymptotic expansion, NOT DT counts. Scope-(a); nothing wired. Beans qou-6ort/qou-btvl.

validation_5_2.why: 5_2's bars are legible in its PDF, so this validates the whole pipeline against a PUBLISHED answer before 6_1 is touched

volume_conjecture_crosscheck.why_independent: the volumes come from SnapPy and never enter the fit; ki6c's printed sigma is used only to pick the 2*pi*m branch integer via its imaginary part

bar_pattern.problem: PDF text extraction cannot see overlines (LaTeX sets them as rules, not glyphs) -- invisible to flat text, layout mode, and a font-metadata pass that DOES recover superscripts and minus signs
bar_pattern.source: Ohtsuki 5_2 eq.(7), where the bars render as an 'N' glyph
bar_pattern.rule: doubled index -> (q)(qbar) = |.|^2 ; difference index -> barred ; reflected pair (q)_m (q)_{N-m-1} -> both unbarred

scope.not_a_dt_count: kappa_i are perturbative coefficients; the DT/Stokes constants need a Borel resummation this does not do
scope.branch_guide: the printed sigma selects the 2*pi*m branch integer only; it is not an input to the fitted value

q0AnchorReason: Reads no q0, on either layer. The Kashaev invariant is a state sum over q = exp(2*pi*i/N) at Nth roots of unity, and the sigma/omega/kappa fit is in 1/N; the substrate modulus never enters. The only external numbers are Ohtsuki's printed sigma/omega (comparison targets, plus the 2*pi*m branch integer) and SnapPy's hyperbolic volumes (an independent cross-check).
